summary: Executed backend+frontend Phase 1 validation on preview URL. Core auth boundaries, controls, guards, and read-only UI navigation passed. Safe reference lifecycle failed at worker test execution, blocking approval/payment downstream flow.

critical.issue: Safe reference worker always lands in NEEDS_REVIEW. test_runs show exit_code=127 with 'python: error while loading shared libraries: libpython3.11.so.1.0: cannot open shared object file'. This blocks WAITING_APPROVAL -> APPROVED -> reference-outcome -> payments lifecycle.
Approval and payment endpoints return 409 in this run because prerequisite state is never reached after sandbox/runtime failure (job never reaches WAITING_APPROVAL/MERGED).

integration_issues.flow: Authenticated owner lifecycle UI (approve -> reference outcome -> payment)
integration_issues.issue: Could not validate end-to-end in UI because backend worker fails before approval gate. Unauthenticated preview navigation and page rendering are healthy.

Re-run safe fixture lifecycle after runtime fix and verify job reaches WAITING_APPROVAL with baseline FAIL + regression PASS evidence.

Run authenticated UI verification for owner-only dialogs and payment flow once backend lifecycle is healthy.

rca of the issue: Reproduction: POST /api/bounty/safe-test/discover -> POST /api/bounty/opportunities/{id}/pursue -> poll /api/bounty/jobs/{id}. Observed status NEEDS_REVIEW with error 'Regression failed...'. Inspecting job test_runs shows baseline/regression exit_code 127 and output 'python: error while loading shared libraries: libpython3.11.so.1.0: cannot open shared object file'. Because worker never reaches WAITING_APPROVAL, approval and payment endpoints correctly return 409 due unmet state prerequisites. Mitigation: fix sandbox runtime library availability/linker resolution first, then rerun lifecycle and finance assertions.
